summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  **No code will be touched by me for this step — this is a plan for the founder to approve.**  ### What I already confirmed by reading the code (no changes made) - Client (`client/src/pages/WatchlistPage.tsx`) has no localStorage/sessionStorage fallback — it's pure React state that always re-fetches from `/watchlist` on mount, using `api.ts`'s `credentials: "include"` (cookies sent automatically). - `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` has its own auth middleware (separate from `server.ts`) that reads the `arca_session` cookie
